topics.title: Self-reported insert benchmark lacks durability and concurrency tests
topics.summary: A laptop test reports 12% lower insert time on a 2GB database, but durability and concurrent writers were not measured, leaving the result narrow.

discussion_points.title: Narrow self-reported insert benchmark
